architectural_shifts: Shift from single-run SHAP point attribution to attribution plus per-instance reliability estimate (r_hat)
Shift from naive diagonal jackknife (cycle 1, 0.976) to covariance-aware CRN/antithetic simulation (0.984) to partition ensemble with budget prior (0.985; sealed final ~0.984)
benchmarks: Model families: logistic regression and other common tabular classifiers owned by the evaluator
reference_query_plan.central_topic: Whether a single run of a budget-limited stochastic Kernel SHAP explainer gives a reliable top-k feature attribution for a trained tabular model, and whether per-instance reliability can be predicted from that one run (within-run variance diagnostics) rather than from repeated runs.
comparators: Improved/variance-reduced Kernel SHAP and regression-based Shapley estimators
Sampling-based Shapley approximation with error guarantees (leverage score sampling)
Feature-selection stability and ranking-similarity measures (Nogueira; rank-biased overlap)
Background-data and expectation-choice effects on SHAP (Yuan; Chen et al.)
core_methods: Kernel SHAP with paired, kernel-weighted coalition sampling at a fixed budget (4d and 16d coalitions)
Repeat-run reliability label: mean top-k Jaccard overlap between a reference run and independent reruns
Single-run self-diagnostic r_hat: delete-one-group jackknife of the regression estimator with covariance-aware rerun simulation
Budget-aware empirical-Bayes shrinkage and partition-ensembled jackknife (best variant)
Calibration of simulated rerun stability and comparison with a gap heuristic and constant baselines
forbidden_query_patterns: chronology of cycles, ideas or search history
deep tabular architectures (FT-Transformer, ResNet) as a main topic: the run evaluates none beyond starter context
queries naming or aiming at a specific prior paper on repeat-run SHAP reliability (access prohibited)

queries.rationale: Reliability label is top-k Jaccard; need justification and comparison with rank-aware similarity measures.
Delete-one-group jackknife of the Kernel SHAP regression is the mechanism behind the single-run diagnostic.

queries.query: empirical Bayes shrinkage noisy variance estimates
queries.rationale: Best variant shrinks the simulated stability estimate toward a budget-level prior.

queries.query: interventional versus observational conditional expectation Shapley values background data choice
queries.rationale: Clarifies that the study targets the reliability of the estimator, not the choice of value function; background resampling is a noise source.

queries.rationale: Dataset provenance for the two evaluation datasets; keep only to find dataset citations.

result_driven_themes: Reliability is budget dependent: mean top-k stability label 0.84 at low budget vs 0.96 at high budget in search; 0.81 vs 0.93 in sealed final
Within-run estimates only modestly rank-correlate with realized stability (Spearman ~0.54) and beat trivial/gap heuristics by small margins (~0.01), with a permuted control close behind
Conditional claim: single runs sufficient at high budget, unreliable for a minority at low budget, detectable only partially from one run
